title: Identity creation fails
why: Shows that when the identity store refuses the user, registration aborts cleanly with the store's errors and nothing partial is left behind.

steps.does: POST …/identity/register-user with a different Email (new.person@example.com) but UserName 'shared.name', which is already taken. All other fields are valid, with Password Str0ng!Pass1 and a matching ConfirmPassword. As a second case, submit a unique username with a password the identity store's policy rejects.

expect: Both requests fail with the identity store's error (duplicate username, or password policy violation). Registration is aborted, no new User row exists, and the existing taken-username-user row is unchanged.
